description: Test whether reported SERPINA6 pathogenic allele frequencies are compatible with the Orphanet disease prevalence of less than 1 per 1,000,000: Hardy-Weinberg expected genotype frequencies versus observed disease prevalence
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Allele frequencies from gnomAD v4 (retrieved this session) for the
# three OMIM allelic variants of SERPINA6 (OMIM 122500.0001-.0003).
# Orphanet 199247 prevalence for the disease: < 1 / 1,000,000.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
PREV_ORPHANET = 1e-6

alleles = {
    "p.Leu115His (L93H, CBG Leuven)\nOMIM 122500.0001, rs113418909":  2.4595e-3,
    "p.Asp389Asn (D367N, CBG Lyon)\nOMIM 122500.0002, rs28929488":    3.5811e-4,
    "p.Asp389Asn in Ashkenazi Jewish\n(gnomAD asj exomes)":            7.04e-3,
    "p.Trp11Ter (null)\nOMIM 122500.0003, rs777245398":               2.05e-6,
    "All 54 gnomAD pLoF alleles summed":                              1.717e-4,
}

print(f"{'Allele':<52} {'q':>10} {'q^2 (biallelic)':>17} {'1 in':>14} {'excess vs 1e-6':>15}")
print("-"*115)
rows = []
for name, q in alleles.items():
    hom = q**2
    rows.append((name, q, hom))
    print(f"{name.splitlines()[0]:<52} {q:>10.3e} {hom:>17.3e} {1/hom:>14,.0f} {hom/PREV_ORPHANET:>15.1f}x")

# Combined: probability of any biallelic genotype across Leuven + Lyon + all pLoF
q_comb = 2.4595e-3 + 3.5811e-4 + 1.717e-4
print(f"\nCombined q (Leuven + Lyon + all pLoF)      : {q_comb:.3e}")
print(f"Expected biallelic genotype frequency q^2  : {q_comb**2:.3e}  (1 in {1/q_comb**2:,.0f})")
print(f"Expected heterozygous carrier frequency 2q : {2*q_comb:.3e}  (1 in {1/(2*q_comb):,.0f})")
print(f"Ratio to Orphanet prevalence (<1/1,000,000): {q_comb**2/PREV_ORPHANET:.0f}-fold excess")

# Observed homozygotes in gnomAD for the two OMIM missense alleles
print("\nObserved homozygotes in gnomAD v4 (asymptomatic population reference):")
print("  p.Leu115His : 3 homozygotes (2 exome + 1 genome)")
print("  p.Asp389Asn : 0 homozygotes")
print("  pLoF total  : 1 homozygote")

# Implied penetrance ceiling
pen = PREV_ORPHANET / q_comb**2
print(f"\nImplied upper bound on penetrance of biallelic genotypes")
print(f"if all diagnosed cases were ascertained: {pen*100:.2f}%")

# ------------------------- figure -------------------------
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5.2))

ax = axes[0]
names = [r[0].splitlines()[0] for r in rows]
homs  = [r[2] for r in rows]
cols  = ["#C44E52", "#DD8452", "#937860", "#4C72B0", "#55A868"]
y = np.arange(len(names))
ax.barh(y, homs, color=cols, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.axvline(PREV_ORPHANET, color="black", ls="--", lw=1.5)
ax.text(PREV_ORPHANET*1.3, len(names)-0.4, "Orphanet reported\nprevalence < 1/1,000,000",
        fontsize=8, va="top")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(names, fontsize=8)
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_xlabel("Expected frequency of biallelic genotype (q$^2$)")
ax.set_title("A. Expected homozygote frequency of each OMIM allele\nexceeds the reported disease prevalence", fontsize=10)
ax.invert_yaxis()

ax = axes[1]
# penetrance gap visual
labels = ["Expected biallelic\ngenotypes (q²)", "Reported disease\nprevalence"]
vals = [q_comb**2, PREV_ORPHANET]
ax.bar(labels, vals, color=["#DD8452", "#4C72B0"], edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylabel("Population frequency")
for i, v in enumerate(vals):
    ax.text(i, v*1.6, f"1 in {1/v:,.0f}", ha="center", fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(1e-7, 1e-4)
ax.annotate("", xy=(1, PREV_ORPHANET), xytext=(1, q_comb**2),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color="#C44E52", lw=2))
ax.text(1.12, np.sqrt(PREV_ORPHANET*q_comb**2), f"{q_comb**2/PREV_ORPHANET:.0f}-fold\ngap",
        color="#C44E52", fontsize=10, va="center")
ax.set_title("B. The penetrance gap: most predicted biallelic\ncarriers are never diagnosed", fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
